finalRegression.scope: All five latest second-batch boundary families together, existing request boundaries and post-action receipts on the final production source.

limits: Complete bounded negative special-service requests only.
No class inventory, membership redemption, home-visit arrangement, visit-mode/type switch or cross-practitioner source change. Unsupported requests need clinic handling.

Exact supported individual cancel and same-practitioner move use source91, preserve source92 and approved service/duration, require separate confirmation and send once. These are individual native changes, not evidence of home-visit or class semantics.
Private class absence and home-service messages require independent proof and separate explicit Cliniko send; a message receipt does not establish service arrangement.
No new native provider operation, positive patient authority, durable patient field, dependency or repository configuration.
Synthetic signed ingress/provider/mail/approval only; no live activation, real delivery or new real-model pass.
Real mail, carrier activation and Splose remain operator-deferred.
